! What is irregular on dev-cisco-reference-bare (20 items; the paste fixes 18, leaves 2):
!  1. aaa      ACCESS     missing: AAA is not turned on (aaa new-model). Fixed by region line 3.
!  2. aaa      ACCESS     missing: tacacs server TACACS: 4 statements (e.g. tacacs server TACACS >
!                         address ipv4 192.0.2.10). Fixed by region lines 5-8.
!  3. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the server group LAB-TACACS: server name TACACS (aaa group server
!                         tacacs+ LAB-TACACS > server name TACACS). Fixed by region line 10.
!  4. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the default login method list (aaa authentication login default
!                         local group LAB-TACACS). Fixed by region line 11.
!  5. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user
!                         always gets in there) (aaa authentication login CONSOLE local). Fixed by
!                         region line 12.
!  6. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the default exec authorization list (without it every new login
!                         lands at privilege 1) (aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS
!                         if-authenticated). Fixed by region line 13.
!  7. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the 'enable' list (it asks the server first, so nobody needs a
!                         shared enable password) (aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS
!                         enable). Fixed by region line 14.
!  8. aaa      COSMETIC   missing: accounting: 5 statements (e.g. aaa accounting exec default
!                         start-stop group LAB-TACACS). Fixed by region lines 15-19.
!  9. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the accounting session id is common (aaa session-id common). Fixed
!                         by region line 20.
! 10. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE (line
!                         con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE). Fixed by region line 40.
! 11. aaa      ACCESS     different: the login method of line vty 0 15: login authentication default
!                         (the device has: the login method of line vty 0 4: login local) (line vty 0
!                         15 > login authentication default). Fixed by region line 42.
! 12. aaa      ACCESS     missing: command authorization: 4 statements (e.g. aaa authorization
!                         commands 1 default local group LAB-TACACS). command authorization is not in

! Not planned: netconf, breakglass.
! Secrets are shown as <SECRET> on lines marked '! VALUE NEEDED, then remove this mark: ': read the
! value with 'tacctl scope secret show lab' (the server secret) or 'tacctl scope snmp lab show
! --reveal' (the SNMP community), put it in, remove the mark.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the
! echo for '% Invalid'. Pasting the region twice is harmless.
!
! Type this first, on dev-cisco-reference-bare, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
! The prompt must end in # (privileged mode), not in (config)#, before you paste: a prompt ending in >
! means type enable first, a prompt with (config) in it means a configuration session is open: type
! end first.
!
!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-reference-bare !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the server, the group and the method lists tacctl renders
aaa new-model
tacacs server TACACS
 address ipv4 192.0.2.10
! VALUE NEEDED, then remove this mark: key <SECRET>
 single-connection
 timeout 5
aaa group server tacacs+ LAB-TACACS
 server name TACACS
aaa authentication login default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS if-authenticated
aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS enable
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 1 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 5 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 7 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa session-id common
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec level 1 show running-config
privilege exec level 7 undebug all
! snmp: the community tacctl renders, retyped as rendered
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP
 permit host 192.0.2.10
 permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any
! VALUE NEEDED, then remove this mark: snmp-server community <SECRET> RO TACCTL-SNMP
snmp-server location Rack 4, DC1
snmp-server contact NOC <noc@example.net>
! mgmt-acl: the management access list tacctl renders (its entries and their order)
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL
 permit 192.0.2.10 0.0.0.0
 permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any log
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
line vty 0 4
 login authentication default
end
